༄༅/khrid yig nor bu lugs bzhugs pa legs so/ /rin chen shog 'dra/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ khrid yig nor bu lugs bzhugs pa legs so/ /

rin chen shog 'dra/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi khrid yig nor bu lugs su gdab pa zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas rnam dag chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las/ /nges pa lnga ldan gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /mdzad pa'i zer gyis gdul bya'i pad tshal 'dzum/ /'gro kun 'dren pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtsho dbus ge sar padma'i snying po la/ /ya mtshan mchog brnyes bde gshegs padma ni/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub la 'dud/ /dpal gyi mchims phu padma'i nags khrod du/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag mkha' 'gros byin brlabs nas/ /gsang ba'i khrid yig rab gsang snying po'i don/ /nor bu'i dbang po nor bu'i lugs 'di rtsom/ /'dir rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying tig gtan la 'bebs par byed de/ de la bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i man ngag gnyis las/ dang po ni gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang rnam dag stug po bkod pa bde ba'i zhing na/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dpal kun tu bzang po yab yum chos sku spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang las/ longs sku rigs lnga lhun rdzogs kyi rnam par bzhengs te/ /chos phun sum tshogs par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po 'od lnga lhun grub kyis bstan pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa longs sku rdo rje sems dpa' la/ dus phun sum tshogs pa gzhir rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med pa'i tshe/ rang bzhin gyi byin gyis brlabs kyis gsungs/ des dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su sprul pa'i sku dga' rab rdo rje la tshig sdeb sbyor legs pa'i sgo nas gsungs/ des rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod du/ slob dpon chen po shṝ sidha la gsungs/ des dur khrod chen po so sa'i gling du/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma thod phreng rtsal la gsungs/ des gzho stod te sgro brag dkar du rdo rje phag mo dang dbyer med pa'i mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsungs/

des mchims phu dpal gyi nags khrod ri mo can gyi dben gnas su padma las 'brel rtsal la gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa ni chos kyi sku'i bstan pa phun sum tshogs pa ste/ thun mong gi sngon 'gros sems sbyang ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gros smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ snang srid bum pa'i lam khyer/ sgrib sbyong maṇḍal gyi lam khyer/ tshe mi rtag pa'i lam khyer/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras kyi lam khyer/ tshad med bzhi'i lam khyer/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i lam khyer/ sgrib sbyong yig brgya'i lam khyer dang bdun las/ dang po ni chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i ngang las/ o rgyan gyi yul 'od lnga'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa na/ thod pa skam rlon gyi gzhal med khang sgo bzhi rta babs dang ldan pa dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus na/ seng ge rin po che'i khri rkang gis bteg pa'i steng nyi zla padma'i gdan la hūṃ mthing nag las/ rang nyid padma thod phreng sku mdog mthing nag gyad kyi dor stabs su bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbu skra dmar ser sbrul nag dang thod skam gyi brgyan pa'i pang na yum mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal dang mkha' lding bza' gnyis mar me'i grib ma ltar gnyis su snang yang ngo bo gcig pas/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing yab la 'khyud pa/ dmar mo rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa ste/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/ rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba/ snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa las mkha' 'gro bzhi dang*/ sgo ma bzhi'i mtshan pa'o/ /gtso bo'i snying nang du rtsa ba'i bla ma he ru ka'i rnam par bzhugs pa/ smin mtshams su padma thod phreng khro bo'i rnam pa la mtshan brgyad kyis bskor ba/

spyi bor kun bzang yab yum la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba'i 'od zer kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim nas/ āoṃ badzra gu ru padma siddhi thod phreng rtsal āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas/ snang srid thams cad lha dang lha mor gyur pa thams cad kyis de skad ces bzlas par bsams nas/ mthar thugs ka'i bla ma la bsdus pa yang mi dmigs par bsams la bsngo ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa sgrib sbyong maṇḍal gyi lam khyer ni/ legs par bkod de gnyis kyis langs la/ phyogs bzhi thal mos skyor te phyi'i maṇḍal tshangs chen gyi bskal pa gcig bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gter srung dang bcas pa la 'bul ba ni/ rigs lnga'i sku las chags pa 'jig rten nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ zlum po dang*/ gru bzhi dang*/ gru gsum dang*/ sog kha dang*/ gzhi phya la ba la sogs par bsams la/ āoṃ ā:hūm̐/ rin chen maṇḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ rigs lnga'i zhing khams rgya mtshos brgyan pa 'di/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces pa gsum dang*/ gnyis pa bkod la/ tshangs pa rnga sgra'i 'jig rten 'og min gyi gnas/ /rnam dag stug po bkod pa bde ba'i zhing*/ /dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs par dmigs la/ ye shes maṇḍal rin chen gzhal med khang*/ /sgo bzhi rta babs 'khor lo rgyal mtshan sogs/ / bkod pa'i sprin phung rgya mtsho legs phul bas/ /'gro kun mkha' spyod bde chen bgrod par shog /ces pa gsum dang*/ gsum pa bkod la/ rdo rje snying po'i 'jig rten rang snang rnam par dag pa'i 'od gsal la dmigs la/ rang bzhin ma skyes gdod nas 'od gsal zhing*/ /sku dang thig les legs par brgyan pa 'di/ /dngos po mtshan ma med par phul ba yis/ /'gro kun gdod ma'i gnas su grol bar shog /ces pa gsum gyis dbul lo/ /gsum pa tshe mi rtag pa'i lam khyer ni/ phyi dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba/

nang 'byung bzhi'i 'gyur ba/ gsang ba 'byung bzhi thim tshul/ skad cig thang cig mi rtag pas kyang rang gi tshe mi rtag par 'chi bar nges par bsgoms pa'o/ / bzhi pa 'khor ba rgyu 'bras kyi lam khyer ni/ 'khor ba'i bde sdug dge sdig gi las las gyur bar shes pas sngar byas kyi sdig pa bshags/ phyis bsdam zhing dge ba 'ba' zhig sgrub par dam bca'o/ /lnga pa tshad med bzhi'i lam khyer ni/ sems can bde ba dang mi ldan pa rnam bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang phrad/ sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa rnams de dang bral/ bde ba dang skyid pa sems can la mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang can rnams sems snyoms par shog cig snyam du snying nas bsgom pa'o/ /drug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i lam khyer ni/ 'di ltar 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya snyam du kun rdzob dang*/ rang gi sems don dam pa stong pa nyid ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin du gsal gdab pa don dam gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa gsum brjod pa'o/ /bdun pa sgrib sbyong yig brgya'i lam khyer ni/ /skad cig gis pad zla'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po yab yum/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūṃ la yi ge brgya pa mthing dmar dkar gsum gyis bskor ba las 'od zer byung*/ bdag dang sems can gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag par bsams la yi ge brgya pa ci 'grub bzlas te/ rjes mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ rang bzhin dag pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs te/ /srid na 'ga' yang mi gnas par/ /thams cad sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces bsngo ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la/

smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i man ngag la/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa gnyis las/ dang po ni skabs 'dir dbang bskur ro// gnyis pa la sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum gyis sems kyi ngo bo ngo sprad pa/ dngos gzhi rnam pa gsum gyis ye shes kyi ngo bo ngo sprad pa/ rjes rgyab chos gsum gyis yid ches bskyed pa gsum las/ dang po la'ang phyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgo gsum gyi 'khrul pa bshig pa/ nang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyang ba/ gsang ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgo gsum gyi gnas lugs bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po la'ang gnyis las/ ru shan dbye ba ni mi med pa'i lung pa stong par song ste/ 'gro drug lus kyi spyod pa sna tshogs byas pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs stangs bya'o/ /'dir zhag gsum byas pas phyis so sor ma byas kyang chog pa'o/ /gnyis pa sngon 'gro dngos ni/ lag pa spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ rgal tshigs bsrang*/ rkang pa'i mthil sprad de nyin mtshan med par gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ngag la'ang gnyis las/ ru shan dbye ba ni dben par sgra skad sna tshogs pa brjod pa'i mthar/ chos kyi sgra dbyangs la bslab bo/ /sngon 'gro dngos la/ rgyas gdab pa/ rtsal sbyang ba/ mnyen btsal zhing lam du 'jug pa gsum las/ dang po la phyi snang ba la rgyas gdab pa dang*/ nang phung po la rgyas gdab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad hūṃ du shar shar gsal ba la/ hūṃ chung mang pos gang nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad 'od gsal gyi zhing khams hūm̐ ye shes lnga'i rang 'od dang bcas pas me re re khengs par bsam mo/ /de'ang ri hūṃ chen gyi rtsi shing nags tshal hūṃ chung la lo 'dab hūṃ phran du bsams te/ hūṃ gi glu snyan la ring bar so dang*/ mchu ma reg tsam du blang ngo*/ /gnyis pa nang phung po la rgyas gdab pa ni/

phyi'i hūṃ de rnams rang gi khong pa'i nang du kha sna dang ba spu'i khung bu nas tshur la sib sib thims nas lus kyi nang khengs par bsam mo/ /de'ang ri lta bu'i hūṃ che ba nang du 'jug dus rang gi lus kyang de dang 'tshams pa'i che ba'am/ yang na til 'bru tsam gyi nang du tshud par bsam pa ni/ snang ba nges med la rig pa gtad med shar nas grol ba'o/ /gnyis pa rtsal sbyang ba la'ang gnyis las/ phyi snang ba la rtsal sbyong ba ni/ hūṃ mthing nag ye shes lnga'i me 'od reg pa tsam gyis thal byung du 'bigs par nus pa/ gang 'bigs pa'i yul dang 'tshams par bsams la/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams med pa 'bigs par bsams zhing*/ hūṃ gi glu drag la ngar che bar brjod do/ /de yang snang ba thams cad sang sing*/ khral khrol 'ja' tshon lta bur mos pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa nang phung po la rtsal sbyong ba ni/ rang gi lus che chung ci rigs par sprul la/ hūṃ des khe khol med par phug pas lus su snang la rags par ma grub par chu'i zla ba lta bur mos par bya'o/ /gsum pa mnyen btsal zhing lam du gzhugs pa la'ang gnyis las/ mnyen btsal pa ni/ shing sdong dang ri la sogs pa la hūṃ gis dru bu ltar dkris nas/ phyir phrol ba la shes pa gtad cing hūṃ gi glu ring bar blang ngo*/ /gnyis pa lam du gzhug pa ni/ khru re'i sar ri mo srin 'gros su byas la/ mthong snang ma zad kyi bar lam gtod pa la hūṃ khru gang pa mthing nag gcig 'gron po 'gro ba ltar song nas/ mthong ba las 'das pa'i phyogs su'ang sngar bzhin song ste phyir mi ldog par hūṃ de song bar bsam zhing*/ hūṃ gi glu ring po blang ngo*/ /gsum pa sems kyi sngon 'gro la'ang gnyis las/ dang po ru shan dbye ba ni/ dben par 'gro drug gi bde sdug dang*/ chos dang chos min dgag sgrub sna tshogs bsams pa'i mthar/ bskyed rdzogs kyi don la gzhag go /gnyis pa sngon 'gro dngos la gsum las/

dang po byung sa la brtag pa ni/ sems ni dang po gang nas byung*/ phyi nang gi yul dang lus rdul phran du gzhig cing brtags pas/ ma rnyed pa ni ye stong rtsa ba dang bral ba'i don rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa da lta gang na gnas brtags pas/ ma rnyed pa ni gzhi med ngos gzung dang bral bar rtogs pa'o/ /gsum pa tha ma gar 'gro brtags pas ma rnyed pa ni sems 'gro 'ong med pa'i don rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa nang sgo gsum gyi sngon 'gros sgrib pa sbyang ba ni/ spyi bor a/ mgrin par su/ snying gar nṛ/ lte bar tri/ gsang bar pre/ rkang mthil du du bsams la/ 'gro drug gi las dang bag chags kyis gang ba sol dong gi du ba 'thul ba lta bu'i spyi bor āoṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ gsum las me 'bar bas yi ge drug dang bag chags kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs nas lus shel gong ltar bsams la/ āoṃ āḥhūṃ gi glu snyan la ring ba 'bum tsho bdun bzla'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi sngon 'gro sgo gsum gyi gnas lugs bstan pa la/ zhi gnas kyi rang bzhin rgyud la bskyed pa dang*/ lhag mthong gi rang bzhin ngo sprad pa dang*/ zung 'brel gyi rang bzhin la bzla ba gsum las/ dang po la'ang sngon 'gro rnal du dbab pas zhi gnas ma skyes par skyes par byed pa dang*/ dngos gzhi sor 'jug pas skyes pa ngo sprad de nyams su blang tshul/ rjes lta stangs gsum gyis rkyen dang bsres te bogs dbyung zhing rtsal spyod pa gsum las/ dang po ni bde ba'i mal du nyal la lus 'gul bskyod dang bral ba/ ngag smra brjod dang bral ba/ sems dran bsam dang bral bas sad la/ khong slod bag phab la phyam gyis skye med bsam brjod dang bral ba'i ngang la 'jog pa'o/ /des ni sems spros bral zhi gnas kyi don skye nges so/ /gnyis pa ni nyan thos kyi lta stangs rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas la/ mnyam par gzhag nas cung zad brtan pa dang*/

byang chub sems dpa'i lta stangs mig bar snang la mda' gang tsam du gtad pas shes pa gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i zhi gnas nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes skye bas de nyid ngo sprad do/ /gsum pa ni 'di nyid cung zad brtan nas khro bo'i lta stangs/ dang po gyad kyi dor stabs ni langs te gom pa bgrad mig har por bltas la zhi gnas bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa 'jigs pa'i sgeg 'gros ni/ gom pa dal gyis 'dor zhing zhi gnas dang bsre'o/ /gsum pa seng ge'i mchongs stangs ni/ mchongs rgyug rgod sems dgag sgrub tu 'phror bcug nas zhi gnas kyi don la rtsal sbyangs pas/ phyis spyod lam thams cad zhi gnas su 'char nges so/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong gi rang bzhin ngo sprad pa ni gsum te/ sngon 'gro gsum gyis ma skyes pa bskyed pa/ dngos gzhi gsum gyis skyes pa ngo sprad pa dang*/ rjes rang grol gsum gyis bogs dbyung shing rtsal sbyang ba'o/ /dang po la'ang gsum las/ dang po rtog pa rtsad gcod pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum po 'di'i byed pa po gang du 'dug /skye ba snga phyir gang la 'gro bar 'dug / dgag sgrub gang las 'byung bar 'dug brtags pas sems su shes pa'o/ /gnyis pa bar du sems kyi mtshang btsal ba ni/ de ltar sems dang lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu 'dug gam tha dad du 'dug

/dga' mi dga' snyan mi snyan skyid sdug tu byung dus sems dang de dag gcig tu 'dug gam/ tha dad du 'dug /gcig na sems la kha dog yod par gyur te lus dang gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /tha dad na so sor gang na 'dug brtags shing dpyad pas/ gcig tha dad rtogs pas brtags pa ma rtogs par med par shes pas thams cad sgro btags glo bur bar gtan la phebs so/ /gsum pa tha ma byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtag pa ni/ de ltar sgro btags glo bur gi sems de phyi nang snod bcud gang las byung*/ sems kho rang las sems byung ngam snyam du sems la dpyad pas/ skye ba'i rgyus stong*/ gnas sa gnas mkhan la brtags pas/ gnas pa'i ngo bos stong*/ 'gro sa 'gro mkhan la dpyad pas rang gi ngo bos stong par shes pas dus gsum rtsa ba dang bral ba'i sems su thag chod kyi rtog pa nyi ma shar ba ltar lhag gis skye nges so/ /gnyis pa skyes pa ngo sprad tshul la/ gnas pa sems kyi rgyun du shar ba/ 'phro ba sems kyi rol par shar ba/ gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du gnas pa'i ngo sprad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'char tshul sna tshogs su shar yang*/ grub pa gang du'ang ma grub pa'i sems 'di la legs par ltos dang*/ dga' mi dga' la sogs pa'i rnam pa rnams sems las gzhan du grub pa e 'dug /dgag sgrub kyi shes pa dang*/ de'i rang bzhin so sor e 'dug /gang snang gi shes pa der 'dzin dang bral ba'i ngang nas phaṭa gyis la / cer gyis ltos la phyam gyis zhog dang*/ rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs zhi ba ltar rtog tshogs chos nyid kyi ngang du lhan gyis gnas pa ni/ rang gnas chos nyid kyi ngo bo ngos bzung phyin chad sems ji ltar gnas kyang de'i ngang la phyam gyis zhog cig /gnyis pa ni yang de'i ngang las rtog pa sna tshogs su spros dang*/ spros pa'i sems de sna tshogs su shar yang*/ ngo bor ma grub par rang grol chu'i rba rlabs dang 'dra ba 'di la/ 'di yin gyi ched 'dzin ma byed par gang shar gyi rig pa gtad med kyi ngang la rang sar yan du chug dang*/

ji ltar 'phros kyang 'phros pa dang grol ba dus mnyam du gnas pa ni ye nas sems kyi gnas lugs yin/ da phyin chad sna tshogs kyi rtog pa la dgag sgrub kyi skyel bsu ma byed par/ da ltar gyi shes pa rang grol gyi ra bar gnyer ga dang ched 'dzin ma byed par yan du chug mdzod/ /gsum pa ni de ltar 'phro bdo ba'i dus na mtshang shes pas gzhi las 'phags mi nus par gnas bdo/ /gnas bdo ba'i dus na rang shar gyi rig pa 'gag med du 'phro bdo yang*/ 'phro gnas gnyis su med pa rgya mtsho la rlabs bu chung shar nas thim pa lta bu ste/ gang ltar shar zhing gnas kyang*/ der 'dzin gyi 'phro ma mthud na chos nyid kyi rol pa las mi 'da' bas/ da phyin chad 'phro gnas gnyis su med pa la re dogs dgag sgrub kyi 'dzin pas ma bslad par mtha' grol klong yangs chen por ngos zung zhig /gsum pa zung 'jug gnyis med du la bzla ba ni/ de ltar gnas pa'i cha nas zhi gnas/ gsal stong shar grol gyi cha nas lhag mthong du ngo sprad kyang*/ 'di yin gyi gza' gtad dang ngos gzung gi ngo bor grub pa gang yang med pas/ bzang ngan gyi nyam snang dang rtog tshogs kyi rol pa thams cad chos nyid kyi rba rlabs shar ba yin pas ye stong rtsa bral chen por la zlos shig / gnyis pa dngos gzhi ye shes chen po la ngo sprad pa la/ rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag /'bring bar dor grol ba'i gdams ngag /tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag gsum las/ dang po la bzhugs stangs gsum la gzhi bca' ba/ gzigs stangs gsum gyis gnad bstan pa/ snang ba bzhi'i 'char lugs ngos gzung ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs gsum ste/ chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seng ge ni/ khyi tshugs mor rkang mthil gnyis sprad pa'i stongs su/ lag pa'i khu tshur bzhag pa bsrang nas mjing pa yud tsam dgyed de mig smin phrag gi nam mkha' la har por blta ba'o/

/longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang po ni pus brang sbyar la/ lag pa'i gru mo sa la btsugs te sor mo 'gram pa la brten cing sbyar ba'o/ / spru la sku'i drang srong tsog pu ni/ /tsog pu'i lag pa mkhal khung du 'khyud pa'am/ /pus mo'i steng du bsnol nas bkab pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni mig gyen du gzigs pa 'phred du blta ba/ mthur la phyed btsum rab tu zim pas nyi ma'i ngos nas khru gang gi sar ma yengs bar blta ba'o/ /gsum pa ni snang ba mi 'dra ba bzhi 'char te/ chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba/ nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba/ rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba/ chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni de'i tshe nam mkha' stong pa la rig gdangs snang ba shar te/ dbyings 'od khyim/ thig le 'gro 'ong*/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud gsum dus gcig tu shar nas/ dbyings kyi nang du thig le stong pa'i sgron ma'i dbus su rdo rje lu gu rgyud bzhag nas bltas pas/ shes pa gsal stong gnyis med kyi ye shes shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma shar te/ nyams su blangs pas thig le sum sbrel gyi snang ba mthong ba tshun chad chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba'o/ /de nas dbyings rig smin mtshams dang bral te/ dang po (< a > dbyings snang za 'og ris ) dbyings snang ling tshe za 'og ris khru gang pa dang*/ thig le sran ma tsam dang*/ rig pa skar mda' rgyug pa tsam dang*/ de nas yang goms pas rim gyis/ dbyings kyi snang ba re lde tsam dang*/ yul gru tsam dang*/ stong gsum tsam du snang ba thams cad kyang*/ rin po che 'dra ba dang*/ drwa ba 'dra ba dang*/ de bzhin du padma stong ldan dang*/ ye shes mkhar thabs dang*/ nyi zla gza' bral dang*/ mda' lta bu dang*/ mdung rtse dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ ral gri dang*/ rtse gsum dang*/ gri gug dang*/ nya mig gi rnam pa 'dra ba la sogs pa'o/ /thig le me long tsam dang*/ 'khar gzhong tsam dang*/ bse phub tsam du snang zhing*/

rig pa 'dab chags lding ba tsam dang*/ ri dwags rgyug pa tsam dang*/ bung ba bcud la 'khor ba tsam dang*/ mi 'gul bar sdod cing*/ thig le dang rig pa'i bar du rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i sku rkyang pa phra mo re snang ba tshun chad nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba'o/ /de nas sku lnga lnga zung 'brel du snang ba'i thugs ka dang*/ rang gi snying gar zer thag phra mos 'bral ba ni rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba'o/ /de nas phyi nang gi rdos bcas nyon mongs dang rnam rtog /'phel snang dang bcas pa zad de/ skabs su rang gi lag sor tsam 'od du snang ba ni chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba'o/ /snang ba bzhi po de rdzogs nas nang gsal gdod ma'i gzhi la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba la the tshom med pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'bring bar dor 'tshang rgya ba la/ mtshon byed dpe'i ngo sprad kyis spyir bstan pa dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi ngo sprod kyis bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni rdo rje sems dpa'i me long bstan la/ 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma phye ba'i sngon rol na/ rang gi rig pa'i ye shes dri ma med pa/ sku gsum ye shes dang bcas pa 'di bzhin du gnas te/ de yang man shel dri ma med pa ngo bo ka dag gi sbubs na/ sku lnga ye shes lnga dang bcas pa 'od gsal du gnas pa gzhon nu bum pa'i sku la thugs rje rig pa'i snying po can du bzhugs pa ni ye thog gzhi'i gnas lugs so/ /de nas 'od phyir bstan la/ gzhi stong pa ka dag gi ngang la lhun grub 'od lnga'i rang bzhin phyir gsal du shar dus/ 'od lnga ye shes kyi rang gdangs las/ dkar po phra phro thugs rjer rig pas/ rang snang rang shar du shes pas gdod ma'i kun tu bzang po gzhi thog de nyid du grol ba'i dpe'o/ /ma shes pas skad cig gnyis par 'dzin pa 'phro mthud pa las/ 'od lngas yul dang lus kyi 'khrul gzhi byas/ phra phro ltar rig pa thugs rje'i rtsal sems su 'khrul te/

las dang bag chags sna tshogs su bsags pas khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams so/ /da lta rang gi snying dbus na gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba de mtshan nyid gsum ldan du bzhugs te/ /ngo bo stong pa shel dri ma med pa ltar ka dag gi ngang nas/ rang bzhin gsal ba 'od lnga lhun grub tu gsal ba la/ thugs rje rig pa phra phro snang ba ltar sems su yod de/ ye shes ni snying na gnas te/ de'i gdangs glo bar song ba rlung gi rtas khur bas sems zhes bya bar song ste/ sna tshogs pa rtogs la ngo bo med par shar ba 'di rang yin no/ /phyis bems rig bral dus rlung bar snang la yal bas gdangs nang du 'dus te/ rig pa lhun grub chen po'i sku nang gsal du dar cig gnas pa las/ rnam shes nam mkha' la thim/ nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim dus/ skad cig dang por stong gsal spros pa dang bral bar gdod ma'i ka dag gi snang ba dbyar ma ston gyi nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba lta bu 'char ro/ /de rang ngo shes pas skad cig la gdod ma'i ngang du grol lo/ /de nas 'od gsal zung 'jug la thim pas zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor snang zhing*/ zung 'jug ye shes la thim pas ye shes bzhi sbyor snang zhing*/ ye shes lhun grub rin po che la thim pas yar ka dag gi snang ba/ bar 'od gsal gyi 'jig rten/ mar 'gro drug gi snang ba mthong ste/ bla ma'i gdams ngag gis grol ba ni/ shel gyi phyi 'od nang du thim pa ltar snang ngo*/ /de'i tshe shel dri ma med pa ni/ ngo bo ka dag gi snang ba'o/ /phra phro dang 'od lnga sbubs su 'khyil ba ni/ sprul sku dang longs sku chos skur thim nas nang gsal bum pa'i skur thim la ma rmugs pa gzhon nu bum pa'i skur thugs rje rig pa'i snying por bzhugs pa'i dpe'o/ /de'i dus na 'od phyir mi gsal yang nang na phra ba'i rnam par yod pa bzhin/ chos sku ka dag gi ngang na rang bzhin 'od dang*/ thugs rje rig pa'i cha tsam du bzhugs pa ni shes rab mkha' la 'khyil ba'i bde ba'o/

/gnyis pa mtshon bya don gyi ngo sprod kyis bye brag tu bshad pa la/ 'od gsal chos sku'i snang ba la gtso bor grol ba rdo rje sems dpa' khong seng gi lam gsang lam rgyud bu chung gi ngo sprod longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i snang ba la gtso bor grol ba zhi khro don gyi ngo sprod/ sprul pa sku'i snang ba la gtso bor grol ba lhun grub rin po che'i ngo sprod dang gsum las/ dang po la chos sku'i snang ba ngos gzung*/ khong seng gi lam la rig pa 'pho tshul/ phyir mi ldog pa dpag chen gyi mda'i gdams pa/ grol nas sems can gyi don 'byung tshul dang lngar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la klad pa dung khang nas khro bo'i 'char tshul/ tsitta rin po che nas zhi ba'i 'char tshul/ thun mong du snying tig gi dgongs pas rgyas par bstan tshul/ de rang ngo shes pa'i man ngag gi gdod mar grol tshul dang gsum las/ man ngag la zhi khro rang snang du shes pa me long la byad shar ba lta bu'i gdams ngag /rang snang lhun grub tu shes pa nyi ma sprin las grol ba lta bu'i gdams ngag /lhun grub rang ngo shes pa ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bu'i gdams ngag /de la btsan sa zin pa rgyal pos rgyal srid zin pa lta bu'i gdams ngag /de nas gzhan don 'byung ba rgyal 'bangs bde ba la 'god pa lta bu'i gdams ngag gdul bya'i don mthar phyin nas sku gsum dbyings su 'khyil ba 'od khyim sbubs su tshud pa lta bu'i gdams ngag dang drug tu shes par byas la ngo sprod do/ /gsum pa ni lhun grub kyi 'char tshul/ rang snang du shes tshul bsam gtan la gnas tshul/ de nyid grol tshul dang bzhir ngo sprad do/ /gsum pa brtson 'grus tha ma'i grol tshul ni/ chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs las/ shar phyogs mngon dgar sprul sku'i zhal mthong nas chos thos/ lho phyogs dpal dang ldan par dbang bskur/ nub phyogs padma brtsegs par lung bstan/ byang phyogs las rab rdzogs par dbugs dbyung*/

dbus khro bo'i zhal mthong bas grol tshul dang lngar ngo sprad do/ /gdams pa'i ngo sprod bshad zin to// //gsum pa rjes rgyab chos gsum gyis yid ches bskyed pa la ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi rgyab chos/ smin pa grol bar byed pa gdams pa'i rgyab chos/ thun mong gi mthun rkyen bsgrubs te rgya mtsho'i rgyab chos dang gsum las/ dang po la dbang bzhi rig pa'i rtsal dbang*/ de nyams su blangs pa bde stong gtum mo dang bcas pa/ zhal gdams gnad yig dang bcas pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa la khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ rgyab chos rtags tshad dang bcas pa/ btags grol 'das rjes dang bcas pa gsum las/ dang po la 'das rjes don khrid dang*/ nor bu'i snying po dang*/ sku gsum lam gyi don khrid dang gsum gsum mo/ /gnyis pa la don gsal me long dang*/ snying po gsal ba dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi dang*/ rtags tshad bstan pa ste bzhi'o/ /gsum pa la btags grol skor dang*/ 'das rjes rnam pa gsum te gnyis so/ /gsum pa la rigs lnga'i bskyed rdzogs/ mkha' 'gro'i gnad yig /bka' srung gi gtad rgya ste gsum mo/ /de dag ni rags rim phye ba ste/ zhib tu bar do'i skor dang*/ de'i bcud len la sogs pa chos sde brgyad cu rtsa lnga po yongs su rdzogs par skal ldan snying gi bu la bstan no/ /des kyang nyams su blangs te 'od lus bsgrub par bya'o/ /'dir ni man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus nas/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i khrid du bsdebs/ /phyi rabs skal ldan myur du thar 'dod rnams/ /yi ge 'di la rtag tu nan tan gyis/ /bdag gis sngon rabs skye bar 'bad pa'i chos/ /deng sang tshe 'dir yongs rdzogs don mthong nas/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du lus gcig dril/ /zab gter yongs gter dgongs gter snying la babs/ /yi ge mi shes don rnams ma sbas par/ /shog ser shog skya shog 'dra'i ngos la bkod/

/phyi rabs skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog /'dir ni khrid yig yid bzhin nor bu'i lugs/ /shing mo yos la mchims phur lung bstan dus/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba btab nas rags rim yi ger bkod/ /dpyid dus babs lugs zab don snying po rnams/ /dngos dang rmi lam lung bstan la brten nas/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /ston gsum me tog 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ /'od zer go chas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /zhib mor bsdus te tshan pa gsum du phye/ /rgya che rab zab shog skya'i ngos la bkod/ /yang zab gnad rnams shog 'dra'i ngos la mnan/ /zab mo'i yang zab shog ser ngos la btab/ /'di ni shog 'dra'i khrid yig gsang ba'i don/ /ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yi ge yin/ /dge ba 'di yis ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med brgal te/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu zhir 'gro ba'i/ /rin chen gling du thams cad phyin par shog /bdag kyang deng nas gangs kyi ri bo ltar/ /ring du gsal bas 'gro ba'i don byed cing*/ /zab mo'i dgongs gter dpag med snang ba yin/ /'dod dgu'i re ba yid bzhin 'grub par shog /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi khrid yig nor bu lugs su gdab pa zhes bya ba o rgyan padma'i thugs kyi 'od zer snying gi padmor shar bas rgyas par byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa padma las 'brel rtsal gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so// //
